turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm cooking for my boyfriend's parents for the first time and I'm torn on the main course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A chicken pie, which is homely and safe, and I can make the pastry the day before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Paella, it's my best dish and it looks impressive, but his mum doesn't really like seafood.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big lamb tagine with couscous, which smells amazing but I've only cooked it once before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The chicken pie is the safest bet, it's comforting and you can prep it ahead. The paella is your strongest dish, but a seafood problem is a real risk with his mum. The tagine sounds wonderful, though I'd rather not try a nearly new recipe on the big night.
